contract.frame_centers: m * hop_size, starting at zero, strictly below sample_count
contract.padding: zeros before and after the source
contract.power_units: linear amplitude squared, not decibels or quantized display values
contract.probe_order: each frame powers array follows its file probe_bins array
contract.pcm_quantization: float32 input, round to nearest even after multiplying by 32768, saturate to int16
contract.mel_boundaries: linear mel from zero to source Nyquist; no bin-to-row assignment specified
